prompt: A photorealistic photo captures the chaotic energy of a theatre backstage moments before curtain call. On the far left, a dancer in a silver leotard stretches her leg high against a peeling green wall. Next to her stands a stagehand in a black t-shirt holding a coiled rope. In the center foreground, an older director with grey hair points urgently at a clipboard held by a young assistant wearing thick glasses. The assistant looks down at the paper while balancing a stack of scripts. To their right, a large wooden crate sits open, revealing tangled cables inside. Perched on top of this crate is a calico cat watching the scene with wide eyes. Behind the crate, a man in a red scarf adjusts his collar in a cracked mirror. Standing next to the man in the red scarf is a woman in a blue velvet dress who is looking at her reflection. On the far right, a security guard in a navy uniform leans against a heavy steel door. Sitting on a folding chair near the guard is a musician with a cello case resting between his knees. The floor is littered with discarded programs and dust motes dance in the dim light. There is no natural sunlight streaming through windows. There is no digital screen or monitor visible in the background.
